articles.headline: 10-man Lens shock PSG to win French Super Cup
articles.description: Lens overcame a first-half red card for defender Kyllian Antonio to battle to a 1-0 win over Paris Saint-Germain in the Trophee de Champions at Stade Bollaert-Delelis.

articles.headline: Are PSG suffering from a Club World Cup hangover?
articles.description: Mark Ogden discusses PSG's chances of retaining the Champions League.

images.name: Are PSG suffering from a Club World Cup hangover?
images.caption: Mark Ogden discusses PSG's chances of retaining the Champions League.

articles.headline: PSG break Marseille hearts to win Trophée des Champions
articles.description: Paris Saint-Germain fought back to beat Marseille 4-1 on penalties to win a dramatic Trophee des Champions in Kuwait.

images.name: PSG trophee des champions celeb [1296x729]
images.caption: Paris Saint-Germain celebrate with goalkeeper Lucas Chevalier after their penalty shootout win over Marseille in the Trophée des Champions
images.alt: Paris Saint-Germain's French goalkeeper #30 Lucas Chevalier (C) is lifted by teammates after PSG won following a penalty shoot-out in the French Champions' Trophy (Trophee des Champions) football match between Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) and Marseille
images.credit: YASSER AL-ZAYYAT / AFP via Getty Images

articles.headline: PSG earn French Super Cup victory over Monaco with late Dembele goal
articles.description: A stoppage-time goal by forward Ousmane Dembele earned Paris St Germain a 1-0 win over AS Monaco in the French Super Cup on Sunday as the Ligue 1 champions lifted the trophy for the third consecutive season.

images.name: PSG TdC celebrations [1296x729]
images.alt: Paris Saint-Germain players celebrate after winning the French Champions' Trophy (Trophee des Champions) final football match between Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) and AS Monaco (ASM) at the Stadium 974 in Doha on January 5, 2025.

articles.headline: Donnarumma fit for French Super Cup after bad face injury
articles.description: Paris St Germain goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma could return to action when the French champions play AS Monaco in the French Super Cup on Sunday, coach Luis Enrique said, after the Italian keeper was sidelined while recovering from a face injury.

Lens overcame a first-half red card for defender Kyllian Antonio to battle to a 1-0 win over Paris Saint-Germain in the Trophee de Champions at Stade Bollaert-Delelis.

Captain Florian Thauvin had given Lens, who won the Coupe de France for the first time last season, the lead against the run of play in the 32nd minute.

Antonio was then shown a straight red card after his late challenge on Maghnes Akliouche six minutes before the break.

European champions PSG, who lifted the UEFA Super Cup on Wednesday night after victory against Aston Vila in Salzburg -- saw a late equaliser from Fabián Ruiz ruled out for offside before substitute Nuno Mendes was also sent off with four minutes left for lashing out at Michal Skoras.

Both Bradley Barcola and Ibrahim Mbaye were absent from PSG's squad for the match as links with a move to Liverpool surrounding the pair.

Lens won the match under new coach Dino Toppmöller, who was hired in June following Pierre Sage's departure to Crystal Palace.

Incoming France coach Zinedine Zidane was at Stade Bollaert-Delelis in Lens for the final.

Information from The Associated Press and PA was used in this recap.
